title: Acquire
viewer: Hiring manager or general portfolio viewer
takeaway: Acquire keeps opportunities, next actions, reviews, and evidence in one local workflow.

scenes.intent: Opportunities were spread across too many tools. Notes, drafts, and follow-ups were split apart.
scenes.headline: Work was scattered across too many tools.

scenes.intent: The next step was unclear. What is approved? What is blocked?
scenes.headline: The next action stayed unclear.

scenes.intent: Acquire puts each opportunity in one place. Each has a status and next step.
scenes.headline: Acquire gives every opportunity one home.
scenes.assetAlt: Acquire Pursuits command center showing opportunity status and next actions.

scenes.intent: Acquire keeps review before action. Review first, then move the work forward.
scenes.headline: Review happens before the work moves.

scenes.intent: Each pursuit keeps its history. Materials, status, blockers, and evidence stay together.
scenes.headline: Every pursuit keeps its history.
scenes.assetAlt: Acquire Pursuits workspace used as public product proof.

hide: real applications, resumes, outreach drafts, and company-specific answers
profile data, browser state, tokens, cookies, and local secret paths
safe: public project name and plain workflow labels
synthetic cards, rails, markers, and proof labels
